import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlBu_r', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=100, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 2. Physical Activity Level distribution by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
box_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == category]['Physical Activity Level'] for category in bmi_order]
bp = axes[0, 1].boxplot(box_data, labels=bmi_order, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#FFE5B4', '#90EE90', '#FFB6C1', '#ADD8E6']
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Physical Activity by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation (top 10)
occupation_avg = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False).head(10)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_avg))
width = 0.25
bars1 = axes[0, 2].bar(x - width, occupation_avg['Sleep Duration'], width, 
                       label='Sleep Duration', color='#4B9CD3', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = axes[0, 2].bar(x, occupation_avg['Quality of Sleep'], width, 
                       label='Quality of Sleep', color='#FF6B6B', edgecolor='black')
bars3 = axes[0, 2].bar(x + width, occupation_avg['Stress Level'], width, 
                       label='Stress Level', color='#6B8E23', edgecolor='black')

axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Top 10 Occupations: Sleep & Stress Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 2].set_xticklabels(occupation_avg.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Heart Rate distribution by Gender and Sleep Disorder
sleep_disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
if not sleep_disorder_data.empty:
    violin_parts = axes[1, 0].violinplot([sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Gender'] == 'Male']['Heart Rate'],
                                          sleep_disorder_data[sleep_disorder_data['Gender'] == 'Female']['Heart Rate']], 
                                         showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in violin_parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('#DDA0DD')
        pc.set_edgecolor('black')
        pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    axes[1, 0].set_xticks([1, 2])
    axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(['Male', 'Female'])
    axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Gender (Sleep Disorder Cases)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps vs Age with BMI Category
scatter2 = axes[1, 1].scatter(df['Age'], df['Daily Steps'], 
                              c=pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category']).codes, 
                              cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Daily Steps by Age and BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=axes[1, 1])
cbar2.set_ticks([0, 1, 2, 3])
cbar2.set_ticklabels(['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese'])
cbar2.set_label('BMI Category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 2].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_yticks(np.arange(len(numerical_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 2].set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add correlation values to heatmap
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 2].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
